summary: det g is a unit at each w ∈ P, where the character is unramified and |det g|_w = 1.

steps.claim: For g ∈ GL_n(O), det g is an integral unit of ∏_{w∈P} E_w, so it has valuation 1 at every w.
At each w ∈ P, χ_w(det g) = 1 because a(x/x̄) is unramified at w (c) and υ is unramified there (charUnramifiedAt_upsilon), and |det g|_w = 1; so the product is 1.
steps.lean:
ext; simp_all [localChar, g.map_det, norm_locField_eq_q_zpow, CharUnramifiedAt, AutChar.spaceChar,
    charUnramifiedAt_upsilon ..]
